name: Bodyweight Good Morning
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and knees soft (slightly unlocked).
Place your fingertips gently behind your head with elbows opened wide.
Keeping your spine long and chest open, push your hips straight backward as if touching a wall behind you.
Hinge forward from your hips until your torso is roughly 45 to 60 degrees forward and you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward to return to an upright standing posture.
coaching_cues: This is a hip hinge, not a squat; your shins should stay vertical as your hips travel backward.
Do not round your shoulders or pull on your neck.
Keep your weight balanced through your midfoot and heels.
